## Checklist

- [ ] `dotnet build` succeeds and committed assets are up to date
- [ ] `dotnet format --verify-no-changes` passes (no style violations)
- [ ] `dotnet test` is green (if tests exist)
- [ ] No debug code left (`Console.WriteLine`, commented-out blocks, memory addresses used only for testing)
- [ ] All user inputs validated before use
- [ ] No unrelated files changed
- [ ] CHANGELOG updated if this is a user-facing change
- [ ] Behaviour verified manually if UI changed (attach a screenshot if useful)
